{$t('task.basic_information')}

{category}

{skill}
{/each}

{$t('task.budget_details')}

{$t('task.budget_type')} {$store.task.budget.type === BudgetTypeEnum.FIXED ? $t('task.budget_fixed') : $t('task.budget_hourly')}
{$t('task.budget_amount')}
{formatNumberForInput($store.task.budget.amount)} Sats ≈ {usdFromSats($store.task.budget.amount, btcPrice)} USDT
{#if $store.task.budget.type === BudgetTypeEnum.HOURLY}
{$t('task.estimated_hours_review')} {$store.task.budget.amount}
{/if}

{$t('task.description_label')}

{$store.task.description}

{#if $store.task.attachments && $store.task.attachments.length > 0}

{$t('task.attachments_review')}

{#each $store.task.attachments as attachment}
{#if attachment.type?.startsWith('video/')} {:else} {/if}
{/each}
{/if}
{#if $store.recurringTask.isRecurring}

{$t('task.recurring_title')}

{$t('task.recurring_message')}
{/if}
